thesis: Momentum is extreme but almost entirely recent: +62% in 21 days and +168% in 63 days versus +144% over 126 days implies a near-vertical breakout off a choppy base. With no fundamentals or valuation data supplied, there is no anchor for fair value, and a >10% down-session already shows fragility. Chasing a 99th-percentile momentum name this extended offers poor risk-reward for a months-long position. Wait for consolidation or fundamental confirmation.
risks: Parabolic 62% 21-day move highly prone to sharp mean reversion
No fundamentals or valuation data to justify entry at 611
Elevated volatility already evident via a >10% single-day decline
